authority: SUPERVISOR_ORDERS seq=29 规则 7c（Roger 2026-09-18 memo 十二）
note: 同一场连续 3 个对白镜同一情绪词 = 写手层 FAIL；performance 必填 emotion（词表内）+ body_action（非上列琐碎动作）+ delivery。

micro_performance.authority: E27 review 2026-11-25 (device 1101) + acting tutorials (小红书 / B站 Foyege): an emotion word becomes 2-3 timed visible beats; the protective layer fails gradually (counter-attack -> self-justify -> crack -> voice break -> admission); disfluency chosen by psychology, on the hardest word only; FACS AU only as an auxiliary tag after the plain visible action

怒.entry_zh: 下颌咬紧，鼻息变重，目光平压住{listener}
怒.entry_en: jaw set, breathing hard through the nose, eyes level on {listener}
怒.change_zh: 眉头往下压拢（AU4），声音一下变硬，下巴往前顶
怒.change_en: the brows pull down and together (AU4), the voice hardens, the chin pushes forward
怒.exit_zh: 盯住{listener}不放，双唇抿紧（AU24），鼻翼还在张
怒.exit_en: holds the stare on {listener}, lips pressed shut (AU24), nostrils still flared

狠.entry_zh: 压低头，眼睛从眉下盯住{listener}
狠.entry_en: head lowered, eyes fixed on {listener} from under the brows
狠.change_zh: 眼睑收紧（AU7），声音压到最低，身体向前压近半寸
狠.change_en: the eyelids tighten (AU7), the voice drops to its lowest, the body leans in half an inch
狠.exit_zh: 停在逼近的姿势，嘴角绷住不动
狠.exit_en: stops in the leaning-in position, the mouth corners held rigid

冷.entry_zh: 脸上没有表情，肩膀不动，只有眼睛在看{listener}
冷.entry_en: face blank, shoulders still, only the eyes on {listener}
冷.change_zh: 眼皮只抬起一点，嘴唇几乎不动地吐出这个词
冷.change_en: the eyelids lift only slightly, the word comes out with the lips barely moving
冷.exit_zh: 目光移开前停半拍，嘴唇合上
冷.exit_en: holds half a beat before the eyes leave {listener}, lips closed

傲.entry_zh: 下巴微抬，视线从上往下落在{listener}身上
傲.entry_en: chin slightly raised, the gaze dropping onto {listener} from above
傲.change_zh: 一边嘴角往上提（单侧 AU12），语速放慢
傲.change_en: one mouth corner lifts (one-sided AU12), the speech slows
傲.exit_zh: 下巴仍抬着，视线懒得再给{listener}
傲.exit_en: chin still raised, no longer bothering to look at {listener}

讥.entry_en: a smile at the corners of the eyes, sizing up {listener}
讥.change_zh: 鼻子里轻轻一哼，一边嘴角歪上去（AU14）
讥.change_en: a short breath out through the nose, one mouth corner twists up (AU14)
讥.exit_zh: 笑意停在嘴角，眼睛却是冷的
讥.exit_en: the smirk stays at the mouth, the eyes cold

厌.entry_zh: 身体微微后撤，视线避开{listener}
厌.entry_en: the body draws back slightly, the eyes avoiding {listener}
厌.change_zh: 鼻梁皱起（AU9），把这个词往外推
厌.change_en: the nose wrinkles (AU9), pushing the word away
厌.exit_en: turns half the face away, no longer looking at {listener}

嫉.entry_zh: 嘴唇抿着，眼睛盯着{listener}身边的东西
嫉.entry_en: lips pressed, eyes on what {listener} has
嫉.change_zh: 下巴一紧，声音里压着酸
嫉.change_en: the jaw tightens, the voice carries a sour edge
嫉.exit_zh: 目光还黏在那样东西上
嫉.exit_en: the gaze still stuck on that thing

贪.entry_zh: 眼睛发亮，身体不自觉前倾
贪.entry_en: eyes bright, the body leaning forward without meaning to
贪.change_zh: 舌尖碰了一下嘴唇，语速加快
贪.change_en: the tongue touches the lip once, the speech quickens
贪.exit_zh: 手指还在不自觉地捻动

急.entry_zh: 呼吸短促，身体已经向{listener}倾过去
急.entry_en: short quick breaths, the body already leaning toward {listener}
急.change_zh: 眉心往上挑拢（AU1+AU4），语速一下加快
急.change_en: the inner brows lift and knit (AU1+AU4), the speech suddenly speeds up
急.exit_en: the mouth still half open, waiting for {listener} to answer

疑.entry_zh: 头微微偏，眼睛眯着打量{listener}
疑.entry_en: head tilted slightly, eyes narrowed on {listener}
疑.change_zh: 一边眉毛抬起（单侧 AU2），句尾往上扬
疑.change_en: one brow lifts (one-sided AU2), the end of the line rises
疑.exit_zh: 眼睛还眯着，等{listener}露出破绽
疑.exit_en: eyes still narrowed, waiting for {listener} to slip

慌.entry_zh: 眼神乱飘，手不知道往哪放
慌.entry_en: eyes darting, the hands not knowing where to go
慌.change_zh: 目光飘开又强行拉回{listener}，声音发紧
慌.change_en: the gaze slides away and is forced back to {listener}, the voice tight
慌.exit_en: one swallow, the hand stopped mid-air

坚.entry_zh: 站定，肩膀放平，眼睛直视{listener}
坚.entry_en: planted, shoulders level, eyes straight on {listener}
坚.change_en: every syllable bitten clean, the chin tucks once
坚.exit_en: the gaze does not give way, lips closed

戏.entry_zh: 眼里带笑，身体放松地斜着
戏.entry_en: amused eyes, the body loosely tilted
戏.change_zh: 嘴角慢慢扬起来（AU12），尾音一挑
戏.change_en: the mouth corners rise slowly (AU12), the last syllable flicks up
戏.exit_en: the amusement stays on the face, waiting for {listener}'s reaction

惊.entry_zh: 整个人顿住，眼睛定在{listener}身上
惊.entry_en: frozen in place, eyes locked on {listener}
惊.change_zh: 上眼睑一下撑开（AU5），呼吸断了半拍
惊.change_en: the upper eyelids snap wide (AU5), the breath stops for half a beat
惊.exit_zh: 嘴唇微张着没合上，人还没回过神
惊.exit_en: the lips still parted, not yet recovered

惧.entry_zh: 肩膀缩着，呼吸浅，视线不敢在{listener}身上停久
惧.entry_en: shoulders drawn in, shallow breathing, unable to keep the eyes on {listener}
惧.change_en: the brows twist upward (AU1+AU4), the voice trembles
惧.exit_zh: 身体往后缩了一点，手攥紧
惧.exit_en: the body shrinks back slightly, the hand clenched

怯.entry_zh: 低着头，只敢从下往上看{listener}一眼
怯.entry_en: head down, daring only one upward glance at {listener}
怯.change_zh: 声音越说越小，视线落回地上
怯.change_en: the voice shrinks as it goes, the eyes drop back to the floor
怯.exit_zh: 头还低着，手指绞在一起
怯.exit_en: head still down, fingers twisting together

哀.entry_zh: 眼眶微红但没有泪，呼吸压得很慢
哀.entry_en: red-rimmed eyes without tears, the breathing held slow
哀.change_zh: 看{listener}不到半秒就移开，用力咽一下
哀.change_en: looks at {listener} for less than half a second, then away; one hard swallow
哀.exit_zh: 下巴绷住（AU17），把情绪压回去，声音没有破
哀.exit_en: the chin tightens (AU17), pressing it back down, the voice not breaking

悔.entry_zh: 视线落在地上，肩膀垮下去
悔.entry_en: eyes on the floor, the shoulders sagging
悔.change_zh: 嘴角往下拉（AU15），话到一半停了一下
悔.change_en: the mouth corners pull down (AU15), the line pauses halfway
悔.exit_zh: 闭了一下眼，没有再抬头
悔.exit_en: closes the eyes for a moment, does not look up again

愧.entry_zh: 抬不起头，手在身侧攥着衣角
愧.entry_en: unable to lift the head, the hand gripping the hem at the side
愧.change_zh: 抬眼看了{listener}一下，马上又躲开
愧.change_en: glances up at {listener} once and immediately looks away
愧.exit_en: the head lower still, the ears reddening

羞.entry_zh: 视线躲开{listener}，脸侧过去一点
羞.entry_en: eyes avoiding {listener}, the face turned slightly aside
羞.change_zh: 嘴唇抿了一下才开口，声音发虚
羞.change_en: the lips press together once before the word, the voice thin
羞.exit_en: the face still turned aside, not daring to look back

怜.entry_zh: 目光软下来，身体朝{listener}靠近一点
怜.entry_en: the gaze softens, the body moving a little closer to {listener}
怜.change_en: the voice lowers gently, the brow unknots
怜.exit_en: the hand stays near {listener}, not withdrawn

喜.entry_zh: 眼睛先亮起来，嘴角还压着
喜.entry_en: the eyes brighten first, the mouth still held in
喜.change_zh: 先呆住半拍，嘴角再慢慢扬起来（AU6+AU12）
喜.change_en: a half-beat of stillness, then the mouth corners rise slowly (AU6+AU12)
喜.exit_en: the smile stays on the face

盼.entry_zh: 身体前倾，眼睛一直在{listener}脸上
盼.entry_en: leaning in, the eyes never leaving {listener}'s face
盼.change_zh: 眉毛微抬（AU1+AU2），声音带着试探
盼.change_en: the brows lift slightly (AU1+AU2), the voice tentative
盼.exit_en: holding the breath, waiting for {listener}'s answer

倦.entry_zh: 肩膀放松地垂着，眼皮半耷
倦.change_zh: 长出一口气，句子拖着说完
倦.change_en: a long breath out, the sentence dragged to its end
倦.exit_en: the gaze unfocused, no effort left

shame.zh: 嘴唇已经做出「{word}」的口型，声音卡在喉咙里，一次浅而失败的吸气，再重新把这个词推出来
shame.en: the lips already shaped for {trigger}, the voice sticks in the throat, one shallow failed inhale, then restarts and pushes the word out

misunderstood.zh: 重音狠狠落在「{word}」上，头随着这个词往前一顶，不加任何字
misunderstood.en: hard stress lands on {trigger}, the head jerks forward with it, no added words

realisation.zh: 「{word}」之前停住一拍，一次吸气卡住没吸上来，这个词才低低地出来
realisation.en: a beat of silence before {trigger}, one inhale that catches and fails, then the word comes out low

hiding.zh: 说到「{word}」前半拍犹豫，眼睛飘开又拉回，换成平稳的语气说下去
hiding.en: half a beat of hesitation just before {trigger}, the eyes flick away and back, then it continues in a level voice

micro_performance.note: Compiled by screenplay_compile (performance_timeline.py) into prompt_spec.action.performance.timeline (fractions of the line's window); tools/bili_carry.performance_timeline_sentences renders the time-coded 'Performance:' sentences.  A disfluency is written as body (lips shaped, voice stuck, failed inhale) -- never as added or repeated words, so the spoken line stays verbatim for subtitles / ASR.
